messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: kv-cache eviction rate spike detected for hosted cluster us-east-1. Alert: kvcache.evictions.rate > 150/s for 2m. Pager: PD-84321. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kv-cache/kv-cache-overview

Alex (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing tail latency increase on text-generation routes. Customers reporting slow responses and a few 5xx. Investigating whether this is eviction-driven or something else.

Evan SRE: Looks like a deploy to kv-allocator-v2 went out ~20m ago (deploy-bot posted). Allocation behavior changed default cache size per shard. Quick prometheus query: 
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m])) by (shard)
```
spiking on shard-7 and shard-9.

Maria (prod): Customer-impact: two paying tenants reported > 5% error rate on generation requests for last 10m. CS looped in. We should prioritize mitigation.

Alex (oncall): Rolling a quick temporary mitigation: increasing per-shard cache cap on shard-7 and 9 to previous value. Running: 
```
PATCH /api/allocator/shards/7 { "cache_cap_mb": 6144 }
PATCH /api/allocator/shards/9 { "cache_cap_mb": 6144 }
```
I also opened a rollback PR for kv-allocator-v2 but prefer config tweak first to avoid full rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy kubernetes/kv-allocator-v2 revision=sha256:4f9b3cc started at 1958408500 by @maria_prod

Evan SRE: After cap bump eviction rate dropped ~60% on shard-7 within 2m. Hit-rate returned from ~46% -> ~72% for affected models. Good sign.

Simon (ml): Note that eviction spikes correlate with model X long-context traffic; KV working set increased after rolling release of the feature. Might need smarter partitioning.

Alex (oncall): I'll silence noisy eviction alert for 30m to prevent pages while we monitor. /ops silence kvcache.evictions.rate 30m 

Priya (oncall): Taking over in 30m for handoff. Can you drop a short summary and next steps? I'll stay on until 21:30 UTC.

Alex (oncall): Summary for handoff: deploy to kv-allocator-v2 changed shard caps -> eviction spike on shard-7/9 -> bumped cache caps to previous levels -> eviction rate and hit-rate recovered -> customer errors reduced. Actions: 1) Verify recovery for 60m; 2) Add granular alerting by shard and model (avoid global alarm noise); 3) Add dashboard panels for per-shard hit-rate and evictions; 4) Long-term: revisit allocator logic to weight hot models.

Evan SRE: For alert tuning: propose change: kvcache.evictions.rate global alert threshold -> make it a per-shard rolling percentile: fire if 90th percentile of evictions/s across shards > 200 for 5m AND corresponding hit_rate drop > 20%. Also add auto-squelch during deploy windows (use deploys.metric).

Maria (prod): +1 to per-shard and model-aware alerts. Also want a dashboard card for “customer-facing impact” that maps tenants to error spike windows. Link to CS dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/customer-impact/errors-by-tenant

Alex (oncall): I'll open a monitoring task: MON-1192 "kvcache: per-shard eviction panels + alert rules" and assign to Evan. Will include runbook snippets and query examples.

Evan SRE: Will do. Draft queries for the dashboard: 
```
# evictions per shard
sum by (shard) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m]))
# hit rate per model
sum by (model) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / (sum by (model) (rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) + 0.0001)
```
I'll add an annotation for deploys to visually correlate.

Simon (ml): For long-term allocator tuning, let's add a telemetry tag for model-hotness and keep top-K hot keys pinned across restarts. I'll sync with product.

Priya (oncall): Handoff notes: system stable after cap bump. Keeping alert silenced until we have per-shard rules in place. Monitoring: watching evictions and hit-rate panels and customer error dashboard. If we see evictions > 120/s sustained for 10m or tenant error > 3% trigger immediate page.

Alex (oncall): Thanks Priya, leaving runbook snippet in MON-1192 and linking PD-84321.

Maria (prod): Filing a customer-facing summary for CS. Also requested credits for affected window; will coordinate once postmortem is out.

Evan SRE: Created MON-1192 and a draft Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kv-cache/kvcache-per-shard (private). Assigning to me, ETA EOD tomorrow for initial panels.

Priya (oncall): I'll keep this open for 2 more hours, then transition to normal ops. If anything flares, add @priya_oncall and incident-bot will page.

incident-bot: Incident PD-84321 status changed -> monitoring. No active pages in last 25m.

Alex (oncall): Post-incident followups: 1) Update runbook to include shard-level triage; 2) Add alert suppression during allocator deploys; 3) Work with ML to identify hot-model telemetry. I'll add to postmortem.

Priya (oncall): Acknowledged. Handoff complete. If anyone wants to add items to the postmortem, link MON-1192.

Simon (ml): Will add model telemetry plan and schedule a 30m sync with Evan and Product for next week.

Maria (prod): Thanks team. CS will keep customers updated. Closing in-thread updates; will wait for final postmortem and monetary impact calc. :thumbsup:
